routes.question: Can the published 1999 per-Pasch switch table be reduced to the exact simple quotient graph and all-pairs distances?
premises: Grannell-Griggs-Murphy Appendix is complete in standard numbering
routes.method: reproduce the published count vector and 79+1 baseline, then compare it with direct reconstruction and exact BFS

routes.question: Does direct canonical reconstruction from 80 representatives yield a complete exact quotient graph?
routes.method: enumerate all Pasches, switch, canonicalize incidence graphs, and deduplicate simple edges

routes.question: Can any asserted edge, component size, or diameter be falsified from exact representatives?
premises: none of the published graph properties are trusted by the breaker
routes.method: independent cycle-graph Pasch enumeration, point-mapping isomorphism, exhaustive replay, and corrupted-input tests

routes.question: Why is one representative per class enough to enumerate all quotient neighbors?
premises: Pasch configurations and switching commute with point relabeling
routes.method: prove equivariance and reduce quotient adjacency to switches in one representative

routes.question: Do parametrization duplicates, self-switches, multiple edges, or a noncanonical catalogue corrupt the graph?
routes.method: set-based occurrence normalization, simple-edge normalization, pairwise nonisomorphism, catalogue equality, and two BFS implementations
